text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing the restlessness; these symptoms strongly suggest akathisia, often a side effect of medications like antipsychotics. How recently did you start or increase the dosage of any psychiatric medications, and do you feel an uncontrollable urge to move while sitting or standing? REQUEST TEST: Current_Medication_List

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced Akathisia secondary to Risperidone.
